panels.description: Full-page hidden-workshop message splash. Bi11bot’s shoulder projector casts a soft-blue hologram above the workbench. Adrian appears waist-up with a narrow expressive face, steady tired eyes, restrained half-smile, practical lived-in inventor’s work clothes and direct gaze into the recording lens. The hologram shifts toward burgundy as he speaks seriously. Alex stands frozen in the foreground with Adrian’s watch glowing on his left wrist. Grandmother stands in the open bookshelf doorway with warm apartment light behind her. Use a descending staircase of isolated lettering zones from upper-left to upper-right, then middle-left, then middle-right, then lower-left, lower-center and lower-right. Keep all faces clear. At the bottom, show a visibly later aftermath: the hologram has faded into scan lines, Alex sits unfolding the photograph, and Grandmother watches.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Hello, Alex. If you're seeing this... then you found the workshop.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Which means your grandmother still refuses to throw anything away.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: If you're watching this, I wasn't there when you needed me. I'm sorry. To you, and to Mom.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I got things wrong, Alex. More than once. But every failure taught me something.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: You don't have to finish what I started. You may find a better way.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Bi11bot has a map. What you do with it is up to you. And whatever he tells you... question everything. Especially me.
